name: Pocket TTS Voice
description: Reads every character reply aloud through a Pocket TTS server with gapless realtime streaming playback. Skips fenced code blocks, can read only the dialogue inside quotes, and has an experimental multi-voice mode that auto-detects "Name:" speakers and gives each their own voice. The server runs separately; this plugin is a pure HTTP client.
author: NnzRP

nnzrp.setupSummary: Requires a running Pocket TTS server (pip install pocket-tts; pocket-tts serve) reachable from this machine. This plugin never starts the server. See the README.
